title: WorkReport
description: Handoff from the worker stage. This is a self-report: the verifier never trusts testsPass, it re-runs the suite itself.

status.description: blocked when the issue cannot be resolved as written

summary.description: Two or three sentences a human reviewer can read in the pull request

testsAdded.description: true if new or updated tests prove the change

testsPass.description: did the test command pass after your change (self-reported)

blockedReason.description: Why the work is blocked. Empty string when status is done.
